title: Abstract normalization residue degree divisibility calculation
statement: theorem normalization_residue_degree_dvd_core {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [IsDomain R] [IsDomain S] [Algebra R S] [Module.Finite R S] [Module.Flat R S] (G : Type w) [Group G] [Finite G] (T : Subgroup G) [MulSemiringAction T S] [IsGaloisGroup T R S] (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime] : q.inertiaDeg R ∣ Nat.card G

proof.text: Apply Mathlib Ideal.ncard_primesOver_mul_ramificationIdxIn_mul_inertiaDegIn at q.under R. Rewrite the common inertia degree using Ideal.inertiaDegIn_eq_inertiaDeg. The residue degree divides the product, hence Nat.card T. Compose with Subgroup.card_subgroup_dvd_card.

statement_change.old_statement: theorem normalization_residue_degree_dvd_core {N V P D : Scheme.{u}} (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (p : P ⟶ V) [IsFinite p] (a : P ⟶ N) [QuasiCompact a] [QuasiSeparated a] (hEtale : Etale p) (hNorm : IsFinite a.fromNormalization) (j : D ⟶ N) (hD : IsRegular D) (hDi : IsIntegral D) (hj : IsEffectiveCartierCenter j) (O : N.Opens) (hcomp : ∀ z : N, z ∈ O ↔ z ∉ Set.range j) (η : D) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ) (x : a.normalization) (hx : a.fromNormalization x = j η) : letI := (a.fromNormalization.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra Module.finrank (N.residueField (a.fromNormalization x)) (a.normalization.residueField x) ∣ Nat.card G
statement_change.what: The original scheme interface is false: p and a are unrelated to G, and its Cartier assumptions do not imply that the ambient stalk is a DVR. Replace the purported abstract geometry with the actual Galois arithmetic calculation. The unchanged root-chart caller supplies a finite flat Galois local model with subgroup T via a separate geometric comparison theorem. No Challenge target changes.

old_proof.text: Localize at the generic Cartier point and identify the normalization stalk with the integral closure of the resulting DVR.
The generic finite etale algebra splits into Galois factors whose degrees divide the finite group order.
Apply the Galois DVR degree formula [L:K]=r*e*f to conclude that each residue degree f divides the group order.
